title: FHRP Concepts: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Every computer has one default gateway. If it dies, nobody gets out. A first hop redundancy protocol keeps a spare ready.

scenes.heading: The hotel concierge
scenes.narration: Two concierges share one desk number. H S R P is Cisco's own, with one active and one standby router. V R R P does the same job, but it is an open standard. G L B P is Cisco's too, and it can share traffic between routers. All of them hand out one shared virtual address.

scenes.heading: Compare
scenes.narration: Here are the defaults. H S R P is Cisco only, and V R R P is an open standard. H S R P says hello every three seconds, and V R R P every one. H S R P calls the working router active, and V R R P calls it master.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.narration: So, to recap. F H R P gives hosts a gateway that survives failure. H S R P and G L B P are Cisco, and V R R P is open. Only G L B P load balances by default. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva FHRP lab.
